meta.name: dataforseo
meta.description: Query live SERP data from Google, Bing, and YouTube via DataForSEO. See exactly what search results look like right now — organic results, featured snippets, knowledge graphs, AI overviews, local packs, and more.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查询谷歌、必应等搜索引擎的最新结果页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做 SEO,需要了解网站在搜索引擎中的实时排名。
copy.tagline_en: See live Google, Bing, and YouTube search results right now
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do SEO and need up-to-date search ranking data.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 DataForSEO 实时查询 Google、Bing、YouTube 的搜索结果页,返回自然结果、付费广告、精选摘要、知识图谱、AI 概览、本地商家包等排名数据。
howto.when: 当用户要求查看某关键词的实时排名、SERP 特性,或需要对比不同搜索引擎的结果时触发。

say.text: 比较“AI tools”在 Google 和 Bing 的头部结果。
say.note: 分别调用两个引擎的 SERP 接口。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can query live SERP data from Google, Bing, and YouTube via DataForSEO, returning organic results, paid ads, featured snippets, knowledge graphs, AI overviews, local packs, and rankings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about live rankings, SERP features, or wants to compare results across engines.

say_en.text: Check the live Google SERP for 'best coffee beans' in the US.
Compare the top results for 'AI tools' on Google and Bing.
Show the top 20 YouTube videos for 'digital marketing'.
